nina: quick triage note  after the new kernel hint landed on canary we see parse p50 climb on small streaming requests. Likely host-side and kvcache interaction.

nina: repro: ```./harness --mode=stream --seq-len=48 --chunk=48 --concurrency=30 --target=canary:8080```
observed: parse p50 5.8ms (baseline 2.5ms), host CPU +65%.

sam: sampled top stacks: host.parse.tokenize, host.stream.frame_parse, kvcache.insert/evict, grpc.writev.

jord: I checked kvcache traces: miss% jumped from ~10% -> ~40%. Keys differ by a small serialized header trailer we added in proto->key.

lee: hypothesis: mini-batch reduction from kernel hint increases request churn and makes kvcache sensitive to even tiny key byte diffs. Two small fixes: stable key serialization + enforce min_mini_batch=6.

nina: validation: forcing KERNEL_HINT=legacy returns parse p50 ~2.6ms and miss% drops to ~12%.

perf-bot: alert perf-1828888888 created and routed to #eng-runtime oncall.

sam: action items: 1) quick patch to key serializer to canonicalize header order, 2) add min_mini_batch guard in selector, 3) add small-stream microbench to CI. I'll open PRs and post before/after pprofs here.
